lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Capitol Hill, 2312. The building is gone; the hill is a lawn. What is here is one room, single storey, unmarked, with four chairs and a table in it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: The Continuity Board. Eleven years reconciling this Enclave and I never saw a line item for this room, because there isn't one. It is not paid for out of anything.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: It is the other way round. This room owns the thing that does the paying.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Four chairs. Not four hundred, not forty. Four.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Board sits above the Steward and the Steward has no mechanism to allocate anything to it, which is the design rather than an oversight. It has met four times in two hundred years. It is not in session now, which is the only reason you are still standing here.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: There is a register on the table, bound, running back to 2031. It is open at the first page, and your own name is on it, in your own handwriting.
